name: klisten-dealgate-mcp
description: Calculate an indicative quote from a supplied catalog and quantity. It calculates supplied discounts and rounds the final line total to currency precision. It is a read-only, stateless calculation: no vendor negotiation, offer acceptance, purchase, payment, settlement or binding agreement. External vendor claims and SLAs are not independently verified. Requires an existing Klisten account and dealrate:price OAuth permission. Existing account and key limits apply; connecting makes no payment.
